projects.title: Butterfly Gardens for Seniors
projects.summary: I build butterfly gardens and raise monarchs to bring joy to seniors living in assisted living facilities.
projects.description:
My great-grandmother loved butterflies. After she passed away, I saw a monarch butterfly, the queen of the butterflies, and it reminded me of her, because she was the matriarch of our family. I had always loved taking care of plants, so I started raising butterflies by planting native flowering plants in my backyard.

This project honors her memory. I create butterfly gardens and bring butterflies to seniors in assisted living facilities, to share the same joy she found in them.

Working in nature and with living creatures brings me joy, and my hope is that these gardens put some smiles on the residents’ faces. Even a small act of kindness can make a difference in someone’s quality of life.

steps.title: Research and planning
steps.text: I researched butterfly-friendly native plants with help from a local arborist, and put together a presentation for the owners of assisted living facilities.

steps.title: Building the garden
steps.text: I cleared a patch of lawn, built a raised garden bed, and planted nectar flowers and milkweed, the plant monarch caterpillars depend on.

steps.title: Raising monarchs
steps.text: Once the garden was planted, I raised monarch caterpillars and protected them from predators until they became butterflies.

steps.title: Sharing them with residents
steps.text: I brought butterflies to a local retirement home so the residents could see them up close, and gave them a photo book of the garden and the caterpillars’ journey to butterflies.

steps.title: Ongoing care
steps.text: I trim, prune and care for the garden every week, and plan to keep building and caring for gardens until I graduate high school.
